blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Senate Impeachment Court on Wednesday allowed corporate counsel Suzette Balucanag-Punay to testify for the defense despite the prosecution’s challenge to her authority to represent two companies linked to Vice President Sara Duterte. Balucanag-Punay, the in-house counsel of GenCorp Industries Inc. and Metro City Chow Foods Corp., was presented by defense counsel Justin Nicol Gular on Day 42 of the impeachment proceedings as the defense’s fourth witness. After Gular’s offer of testimony, private prosecutor Lorna Kapunan questioned whether Balucanag-Punay had been authorized through board resolutions or secretaries’ certificates from both companies to testify and identify corporate documents before […]...
